development.name: Runelic
development.statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
development.works: Adds the Runelic script: a Runelic Banner Pattern item (crafted from paper, amethyst shard, echo shard and ghast tear, sold by clerics and wandering traders), 40-odd banner patterns (letters, digits, signs) and a font.
development.note: From Modrinth, unchanged (with its data from Horizon's mod browser). Not yet: The pattern item's and banner patterns' textures are the mod's own assets, shown only with Horizon's import of its data; the loom is a game screen; the mod works without it
